head_string_definition.controlled_paraphrase: The Head String is parallel to the bottom cushion, 635 mm from that cushion, and intersects both side cushions.

offense_clause.controlled_paraphrase: The cue ball is placed behind the Head String. More than half crossing produces a reminder for the first offense and a foul for a later offense after the break.

text_does_not_specify: whether the authoritative measurement is at placement commit, shot release, or post-break adjudication
whether preview or rejected placement attempts are offenses
whether the per-player offense history resets per rack, match, set, or event
the numerical tolerance or quantization policy at the exact-half boundary

frozen_audit.gap: No half-ball crossing measurement or reminder/offense escalation exists.

geometry_contract.world_axis: The table longitudinal axis is world Z; -Z is the head/bottom-cushion side and +Z is the foot/top-cushion side.
geometry_contract.measurement_object: the cue-ball circular footprint projected onto the table plane
geometry_contract.mathematical_equivalence: For a circle bisected by a zero-width line, more than half of its footprint is on the foot side if and only if its center is on the foot side.
geometry_contract.exact_half_boundary: signed_crossing_cm == 0 is exactly half and is not an offense under the words more than half
geometry_contract.foot_side_example: signed_crossing_cm > 0 is a geometric violation candidate

authoritative_measurement_time.reason: Clause 6(d) does not identify the authoritative event at which the cue-ball position is sampled.

per_player_history_reset_scope.reason: Clause 6(d) defines first and later offense consequences but does not define the lifetime of that history.

existing_core_g_mapping.current_validation: A Section 8 placement center must be strictly behind the Head String; the line itself and foot-side centers are rejected.

must_not_count: drag preview samples, including repeated samples
UI previews rejected by geometry validation
confirm attempts rejected before an authoritative ACK
wrong actor, action, flow, decision ID, revision, state hash, or idempotency conflicts
accepted Section 8 ball-in-hand placement outside a distinct Section 6(d) break context
raw live cue-ball positions after physics has started
future_count_preconditions: the classification gate selects exactly one authoritative measurement time
the request or frozen launch fact is in a distinct WPA-II-06-D break context
actor/player identity and authority revision are exact
the sampled position is finite and comes from committed or frozen authoritative state
the geometry predicate is true under the selected deterministic numeric policy
the mutation key has not already been consumed
product_submission_contract.placement_commit_candidate: Count only after a successful authoritative Section 6(d) placement ACK; preview and failed submission remain read-only.
product_submission_contract.shot_release_candidate: Count only when the break shot is accepted for launch, using the last committed cue-ball position frozen before motion.
product_submission_contract.post_break_candidate: Count exactly once during break adjudication using the launch position frozen before motion, never the simulated post-shot cue-ball position.

per_player_history_contract.state_shape: one offense count per player within the later-selected reset scope
per_player_history_contract.first_geometric_offense_for_player: atomically increment that player's count from 0 to 1 and emit one reminder; do not mark a foul
per_player_history_contract.later_geometric_offense_for_same_player: atomically increment that player's count and emit one foul classification exactly once

transaction_order: validate unique authority event and exact break context
freeze and validate actor, revision, position, and policy scope
read only the actor's per-player history
derive reminder or foul without mutating
commit history, authority revision, event/action, adjudication effect, receipt, and state hash as one transaction
atomic_mutation_contract.failure_rollback: Any validation, classification, persistence, or downstream commit failure restores cue state, match state, both players' histories, authority revision, events/actions, and receipts byte-for-byte.
atomic_mutation_contract.idempotent_retry: An exact retry returns the original ACK or adjudication receipt with no second history increment, reminder, foul, event, action, or revision.
atomic_mutation_contract.conflicting_retry: A reused key with different actor, position, context, revision, or action fails closed with no mutation.

forbidden_scope: production source edits in this design-gate task
physics solver interpretation of the rule
counting preview or rejected UI attempts
